pictures.name: steps_cut_in_rock
pictures.scene: a flight of shallow steps cut straight into a shoulder of pale rock and climbing out of the bottom of the frame, the lowest treads lit warm and hard from one side, the slope above them going quiet and dim

pictures.name: staff_against_the_rock
pictures.scene: one long staff of worn wood leaning against a boulder in a dry upland pasture, the grain of the wood lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the empty hillside beyond it flat and hazy and still

pictures.name: doorway_not_entered
pictures.scene: an open house doorway seen from outside at deep night, one small lamp burning on the threshold at the bottom of the frame, the room past the opening entirely dark and the wall above it plain and unlit

pictures.name: cleared_ground
pictures.scene: a wide patch of bedrock swept bare and level on a hilltop with the loose stones piled aside, the cleared rock lit warm and low along the bottom of the frame, the sky above it broad and empty and waiting

pictures.name: field_at_the_wood_edge
pictures.scene: a stubble field running up to the dark edge of an oak wood at dusk, the near stubble lit gold along the bottom of the frame, the trees beyond standing close and quiet without any light in them at all

pictures.name: low_footstool_of_stone
pictures.scene: a single low block of dressed stone set on a swept floor as a footstool, its worn top lit warm from one side at the bottom of the frame, the wide floor and wall beyond it dim and unbroken and quiet

pictures.name: covenant_chest_with_poles
pictures.scene: a chest of acacia wood overlaid with gold, long carrying poles run through the rings on its sides, standing alone on bare stone and lit warm and low, the deep shade above it holding nothing at all

pictures.name: white_linen_folded
pictures.scene: a stack of clean white linen folded square on a bench of cedar, the topmost fold lit soft and warm at the bottom of the frame, the room above the bench opening away into a still and even brown shadow

pictures.name: oil_horn_on_stone
pictures.scene: a curved horn flask stoppered and full of oil, lying on a flat slab of stone and lit warm along its length at the bottom of the frame, the ground beyond it falling away into quiet evening shade

pictures.name: stone_pillar_set_upright
pictures.scene: one tall unworked stone set upright alone on a bare ridge, its foot lit warm and hard by a low sun, the great length of it rising dark and plain against a wide and cloudless and entirely empty sky

pictures.name: carved_seat_waiting
pictures.scene: an empty seat of carved cedar standing on a low dais in a quiet hall, its arms and footrest lit warm from one side at the bottom of the frame, the hall behind it deep and dark and altogether still

pictures.name: hill_of_the_city
pictures.scene: a broad hill crowned with old stone walls at first light, the terraces at its foot lit warm and green along the bottom of the frame, the walls above them and the sky beyond them soft and pale and plain

pictures.name: hearth_stone_swept
pictures.scene: a wide hearth of flat stones swept clean with a low fire newly set in it, the embers and the nearest stones lit warm and red, the room above the hearth quiet and brown and empty and undisturbed

pictures.name: loaves_heaped_in_a_basket
pictures.scene: a deep reed basket heaped over with round flat loaves, the topmost bread lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the table and the wall behind it falling away into a soft and even dim shade

pictures.name: courtyard_lamps_lit
pictures.scene: a wide paved courtyard at evening with small oil lamps set out along its low walls, the flames and the nearest paving lit warm and gold, the open middle of the court dim and quiet and entirely empty

pictures.name: lamp_set_ready
pictures.scene: one bronze lamp filled and trimmed and standing ready on a plain stone ledge, its bowl lit warm from the flame at the bottom of the frame, the wall above it rising dark and smooth and completely bare

pictures.name: crown_catching_the_light
pictures.scene: a plain circlet of worked gold resting on dark polished stone, its rim catching one hard warm line of light at the bottom of the frame, the dark above and behind it deep and entirely without detail

lines.text: A song of ascents.
O LORD, remember on behalf of David
all the hardships he endured,
how he swore an oath to the LORD,
and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
“I will not enter my house
or get into my bed,
I will not give sleep to my eyes
or slumber to my eyelids,
until I find a place for the LORD,
a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
We heard that the ark was in Ephrathah;
we found it in the fields of Jaar.
Let us go to His dwelling place;
let us worship at His footstool.
Arise, O LORD, to Your resting place,
You and the ark of Your strength.
May Your priests be clothed with righteousness,
and Your saints shout for joy.
For the sake of Your servant David,
do not reject Your anointed one.
The LORD swore an oath to David,
a promise He will not revoke:
“One of your descendants
I will place on your throne.
If your sons keep My covenant
and the testimony I will teach them,
then their sons will also sit on your throne
forever and ever.”
For the LORD has chosen Zion;
He has desired it for His home:
“This is My resting place forever and ever;
here I will dwell, for I have desired this home.
I will bless her with abundant provisions;
I will satisfy her poor with bread.
I will clothe her priests with salvation,
and her saints will sing out in joy.
There I will make a horn grow for David;
I have prepared a lamp for My anointed one.
I will clothe his enemies with shame,
but the crown upon him will gleam.”
